recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結結構消失，被大量背靠背、大小相近、邊界模糊的淡染腫瘤性濾泡取代，濾泡間有纖維束穿插，缺乏正常極性與清楚套區，符合濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Effacement of nodal architecture by numerous closely packed, back-to-back neoplastic follicles
Follicles are enlarged, similar in size and shape, with pale monotonous centers
Attenuated or absent mantle zones; thin dark interfollicular lymphoid rims
Interlacing sclerotic collagen bands between follicles
Cytologic grade (centroblast count) not assessable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power view of a lymph node shows complete effacement of the normal architecture by numerous back-to-back, enlarged, monotonous follicles with attenuated mantle zones and interlacing fibrous bands. The follicles lack the size variation and polarization of reactive germinal centers. Grading requires high-power evaluation of centroblasts and assessment for solid sheets of centroblasts, which cannot be performed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a follicular lymphoma; the grade 3B designation requires high-power confirmation.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles vary in size and shape, show polarization with tingible-body macrophages and intact mantles, and are BCL2 negative in germinal centers.
NLPBCL nodules are larger, composed of small lymphocytes with scattered LP (popcorn) cells, and lack BCL2-positive germinal center B cells.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma arising in follicular lymphoma
ddx.vs: DLBCL shows diffuse sheets of large cells without follicular dendritic meshworks, which must be excluded in FL grade 3B.
MCL nodules are composed of monotonous small cleaved cells that are cyclin D1 and SOX11 positive.
